import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    feature_cols = [
        "num_orders", "num_items", "total_price", "total_freight",
        "mean_price", "max_price", "min_price", "std_price",
        "nunique_seller", "nunique_customer", "mean_freight",
        "mean_review", "review_count", "mean_payment_total",
        "mean_payment_installments", "mean_payment_count",
        "days_since_last", "product_age_days", "sales_per_month",
        "review_rate", "mean_delivery_delay", "has_sales",
        "recency_weighted_sales", "sales_last_30d", "sales_last_90d",
        "sales_prev_90d", "trend_90d", "mean_delivery_days",
        "delivered_ratio", "mean_review_recent", "low_review_share",
    ]

    def empty_result():
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"),
                            columns=feature_cols)

    # Only sales that already happened before seed_time
    mask_items = order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask_items].copy()

    if items.empty:
        return empty_result()

    # Orders info: delivery dates are known only if delivery happened before seed_time
    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "customer_id",
                         "order_delivered_customer_date",
                         "order_estimated_delivery_date"]].copy()
    orders_sub.loc[orders_sub["order_delivered_customer_date"] >= seed_time,
                   "order_delivered_customer_date"] = pd.NaT

    items = items.merge(orders_sub, how="left", on="order_id")

    # Payments: only those recorded before seed_time
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        pay_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        pay_total=("payment_value", "sum"),
        pay_install_avg=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Reviews: only reviews already created before seed_time
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        rev_count=("review_score", "count"),
        rev_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
    ).reset_index()

    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    grouped = items.groupby("product_id")

    feat = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_orders": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "num_items": grouped["price"].count(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "mean_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "max_price": grouped["price"].max(),
        "min_price": grouped["price"].min(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std(),
        "nunique_seller": grouped["seller_id"].nunique(),
        "nunique_customer": grouped["customer_id"].nunique(),
        "mean_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "mean_review": grouped["rev_mean"].mean(),
        "review_count": grouped["rev_count"].sum(),
        "mean_payment_total": grouped["pay_total"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_installments": grouped["pay_install_avg"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_count": grouped["pay_count"].mean(),
        "first_ts": grouped["ts"].min(),
        "last_ts": grouped["ts"].max(),
ecently_added = None
    })

    # Time-based features
    feat["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - feat["last_ts"]).dt.days
    feat["product_age_days"] = (seed_time - feat["first_ts"]).dt.days
    age_pos = feat["product_age_days"].clip(lower=1)
    feat["sales_per_month"] = feat["num_orders"] * 30 / age_pos
    feat["review_rate"] = feat["review_count"] / feat["num_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Recency-weighted sales (exponential decay, half-life 60 days)
    items["age_days"] = (seed_time - items["ts"]).dt.days.clip(lower=0)
    items["w"] = 0.5 ** (items["age_days"] / 60.0)
    feat["recency_weighted_sales"] = items.groupby("product_id")["w"].sum()

    # Window sales counts
    for col, days in [("sales_last_30d", 30), ("sales_last_90d", 90), ("sales_prev_90d", 180)]:
        m = items["age_days"] < days
        feat[col] = items[m].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    feat["trend_90d"] = feat["sales_last_90d"] - feat["sales_prev_90d"]

    # Delivery features (only delivered-before-seed_time orders count)
    delivered = items[items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()].copy()
    delivered["delivery_days"] = (
        delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered["ts"]
    ).dt.days
    delivered["delivery_delay"] = (
        delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.days
    feat["mean_delivery_days"] = delivered.groupby("product_id")["delivery_days"].mean()
    feat["mean_delivery_delay"] = delivered.groupby("product_id")["delivery_delay"].mean()
    feat["delivered_ratio"] = delivered.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique() / feat["num_orders"]

    # Recent review quality (last 180 days of reviews relative to purchase ts)
    recent_items = items[items["age_days"] <= 180]
    feat["mean_review_recent"] = recent_items.groupby("product_id")["rev_mean"].mean()
    low = items[items["rev_mean"] <= 2]
    feat["low_review_share"] = low.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique() / feat["num_orders"]

    feat["has_sales"] = 1

    feat = feat.drop(columns=["first_ts", "last_ts"], errors="ignore")
    feat = feat.fillna(0)
    feat = feat.reindex(pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"), fill_value=0)
    feat = feat[feature_cols]
    return feat
